title: Split wsg_grabber/downloader.py under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring python_pkg/wsg_grabber/downloader.py (420 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line file cap by separating the Worker class's two independent halves -- walking the board and fetching a claimed file -- into mixins, with no change to behaviour, to the public Worker API, or to how the tests drive it.
acceptance_criteria: downloader.py, _scan.py, _fetch.py and _worker_base.py are each at most 250 lines.
All 277 python_pkg/wsg_grabber tests pass unchanged, including the ones that call worker._download_one() and worker._fetch_thread() as bound methods.
The package holds 100% branch coverage: no new uncovered lines are introduced by the split (in particular, no NotImplementedError stub bodies).
pre-commit passes on all four files with no suppression added -- no # noqa, no # type: ignore, no pylint disable, no new per-file-ignores in meta/pyproject.toml.
out_of_scope: Any behaviour, retry, backoff or state-transition change.
Any change to the test files.
Splitting the wsg_grabber test files -- that is separate work.
Adding pylint mixin configuration to meta/pyproject.toml.
verifier: pre-commit run --files python_pkg/wsg_grabber/downloader.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_scan.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_fetch.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_worker_base.py (runs ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and the coverage-gated pytest), plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the cap itself.
